text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy to see you enjoying our 
arcade cabinet! Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, as expected of you, Trainer! If you 
get the hang of it a bit more, you'll 
become a crane game master in no time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, maybe you and I could have a 
contest to see who can gather more within 
the time limit... Fufu. I look forward to 
it.
